brief: Makes sound in one line from a string of note names, a phrase of degrees in a tradition, lyrics or live loops.
detail: It owns no mechanism: each verb is a line over stzSoundScore, stzSoundScoreRenderer, stzSoundScheduler, stzSoundUniverse and stzSoundLive. Tempo, With and Swing apply to the note-string verbs (Play, ToSound, ScoreOf); the phrase verbs take their speed and instrument from the chosen universe. Play, PlayPhrase and the live loops on a sound card open an audio device and were not run in this reference; ToSound, ScoreOf, PhraseToSound and Sing render to memory. Live().CaptureInsteadOfDevice(seconds, FALSE) keeps the live verbs off the sound card. The sound has not been heard by a person (UNPERCEIVED): it is checked by frame count, sample rate and peak level, not by listening.
